name: Lvgl → Page Next
description: This [action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#actions-action) changes the page to the next/previous based on the configuration (pages with their `skip` option enabled are...skipped). Page changes will wrap around at the end.

config_entries.label: Animation
config_entries.description: Animate page changes as specified. One of: `NONE`, `OVER_LEFT`, `OVER_RIGHT`, `OVER_TOP`, `OVER_BOTTOM`, `MOVE_LEFT`, `MOVE_RIGHT`, `MOVE_TOP`, `MOVE_BOTTOM`, `FADE_IN`, `FADE_OUT`, `OUT_LEFT`, `OUT_RIGHT`, `OUT_TOP`, `OUT_BOTTOM`. Defaults to `NONE`.

config_entries.label: Time
config_entries.description: Duration of the page change animation. Defaults to `50ms`.
